name: Mahjong Table VR
summary:
Sit at a real mahjong table without leaving your room. Mahjong Table VR is full four-player Singapore mahjong with real physics: you pick tiles off the wall, rack them, and throw your discards onto the felt.

Play solo against three bots, or host a table and have up to three friends join from a phone or laptop with a room code. They don't need a headset and joining is free. Voice chat is built in, so the table talk comes with it.

Singapore scoring, done properly: flowers and animals with instant payouts, r
